research_notes: The final close should occur at the first safe unit boundary after the target rather than intentionally overshooting to consume budget.
Overshoot is measured, not optimized for.
This prevents the experiment from turning into idle timeout chasing.
If a unit crosses the target naturally, its bounded tail is legitimate substantive work.
The close overhead then begins at pre_close_ts after that unit finishes.
This definition supports later soft-cutoff admission analysis.
